stories.title: Did GOP efforts to redistrict the House turn into a dummymander?
stories.summary: Republicans undertook a historic effort to redraw several states' congressional districts mid-decade in an attempt to maintain control of the House.
stories.why: District lines translate votes into seats, and interested actors draw them.
stories.watch: Texas and Florida seats drawn on 2024 margins: do they hold in a less favorable environment?

stories.title: Democrats unveil 2028 debate rules with new dark money restrictions — but there's a catch
stories.summary: The DNC's 2028 Democratic primary rules require candidates to denounce dark money from super PACs and 501(c)(4) groups to qualify for 12 debate stages.
stories.why: Nominations reveal bargaining among a party’s factions.
stories.watch: Whether primary losers’ supporters return in November, and how replacement nominees perform.

stories.title: How a GOP redistricting 'dummymander' in North Carolina backfired by 2 seats
stories.summary: In North Carolina, Republican lawmakers redrew voting maps, aiming to gain one seat in Congress. Instead, they lost two seats, in a classic example of what political scientists call a "dummymander."
stories.why: District lines translate votes into seats, and interested actors draw them.
stories.watch: Texas and Florida seats drawn on 2024 margins: do they hold in a less favorable environment?

stories.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang still testifying before Congress next week
stories.summary: Jensen Huang is still set to testify before lawmakers next week, congressional panels confirmed, after he was reinstated as Nvidia's CEO Monday, after resigning earlier this month amid allegations of affairs.
stories.why: Experienced, scandal-free candidates tend to beat what partisanship predicts.
stories.watch: Performance relative to co-partisans on the same ballot.

stories.title: Democratic congressman resigns over sexual misconduct allegations
stories.summary: Democratic Congressman Jimmy Gomez said he disagreed with a devastating Ethics Committee report but will resign next week. NBC News’ Monica Alba reports.
stories.why: Experienced, scandal-free candidates tend to beat what partisanship predicts.
stories.watch: Performance relative to co-partisans on the same ballot.

stories.title: California Democrat Rep. Gomez resigns following ethics report on sexual misconduct allegations
stories.summary: California Congressman Rep. Jimmy Gomez says he will resign after a House Ethics report concluded Gomez's actions violated House rules by "making unwelcome sexual advances."
stories.why: Experienced, scandal-free candidates tend to beat what partisanship predicts.
stories.watch: Performance relative to co-partisans on the same ballot.

stories.title: Huang's reinstatement at Nvidia sparks fury in Congress as lawmakers move forward with hearings
stories.summary: Nvidia was already facing sharp scrutiny from Congress after Huang acknowledged a relationship with a Chinese businesswoman whom U.S. officials believed to be a spy.
stories.why: Voters reward or punish the party in power for conditions they experience.
stories.watch: Whether vote choice tracks evaluations of the economy and the Iran war in exit polls and AP VoteCast, and whether places more exposed to fuel prices move differently.

stories.title: Progressives unveil $25 minimum wage push to solve affordability crisis despite economist inflation warning
stories.summary: House Democrats push a $25 minimum wage to fight the affordability crisis, but Heritage economist E.J. Antoni warns it could raise costs and unemployment.
